response.original_title: Playboy: The Girls of the Cabaret Royale
response.overview: World-renowned as the premiere gentlemen’s club, The Cabaret Royale in Dallas, Texas has gained legions of loyal fans. Now, we’ll show you why in this exclusive insider’s view. Reminiscent of the golden age of cabaret when sophistication and style were the standard, The Cabaret Royale features stunningly beautiful nude women in a fabulous floorshow (or, in more personal routines right at guests’ tables). You’ll see it all live, then meet these enchanting entertainers in intimate interviews. Whatever your pleasure, you’re certain to have a royally good time!
